name: Morse Hydraulics
tagline: Agentic ops for multi-location hydraulic hose, fittings, and mobile van service.
overview: Morse Hydraulics specializes in high-pressure hydraulic hoses, fittings, quick connects, greaser systems, and while-you-wait assemblies across CA, WA, OR, and TX. Agentic AI can speed parts identification, cross-location inventory, quote turnaround, and mobile dispatch without replacing counter expertise on safety-critical assemblies.
painPoints: Customers need the right hose/fitting match across SAE, metric, BSP, Japanese, and Caterpillar standards under time pressure
Inventory and capacity are fragmented across multiple branches and mobile vans
Quotes, credit checks, and emergency mobile dispatch still rely on phone tag and tribal knowledge
strategicImpact: Faster first-pass parts identification and quote turnaround
Higher fill rates via cross-branch inventory visibility
Shorter emergency mobile-van response time with better route/tech matching

singleAgents.name: Hose & Fitting Identifier
singleAgents.role: Matches customer specs/photos to the correct hose, fitting, and adapter SKUs
singleAgents.trigger: Counter inquiry, email with photo/spec, or web contact form
singleAgents.output: Ranked SKU matches with pressure rating, compatibility notes, and in-stock locations
singleAgents.roi: 5–15 min saved per complex ID; fewer wrong-part remakes

singleAgents.name: While-You-Wait Quote Agent
singleAgents.role: Builds assembly quotes from BOM, labor, and branch capacity
singleAgents.trigger: Customer requests hose assembly while waiting or same-day
singleAgents.output: Line-item quote + ETA by branch + upsell options (guards, QDs, gauges)
singleAgents.roi: Faster counter throughput; more consistent margin on assemblies

singleAgents.name: Mobile Van Dispatch Agent
singleAgents.role: Prioritizes emergency mobile service jobs and suggests routing
singleAgents.trigger: Mobile emergency call or after-hours service request
singleAgents.output: Recommended van/tech, ETA, parts to stage, and customer confirmation script
singleAgents.roi: Faster emergency response; fewer dry runs missing fittings

singleAgents.name: Multi-Branch Inventory Scout
singleAgents.role: Finds hard-to-get fittings across Morse locations and suggests transfer/pickup
singleAgents.trigger: Local stockout on fittings, Manuli hose, or specialty adapters
singleAgents.output: Nearest availability + transfer vs. buy decision + customer options
singleAgents.roi: Higher capture on specialty orders; less lost business to competitors

multiAgent.name: Service Counter Swarm
multiAgent.description: A supervisor-led team that takes a customer from part identification through quote, stock confirmation, and counter or mobile fulfillment across Morse branches.

supervisor.name: Counter Operations Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns the customer job outcome, sequences identification → pricing → inventory → fulfillment, and escalates ambiguous high-pressure or safety-critical specs to human techs.
supervisor.routingLogic: Unknown part → Identifier Agent; pricing/ETA → Quote Agent; stockout → Inventory Scout; onsite emergency → Dispatch Agent; credit/account issues → human sales/credit.

subAgents.name: Spec Intake Agent
responsibilities: Extract size, pressure, temp, media, ends, and length
Ask clarifying questions when markings are incomplete
subAgents.contextHandoff: Normalized job spec packet to Supervisor

subAgents.name: Catalog Match Agent
responsibilities: Apply Manuli and brand compatibility rules
Note SAE vs metric vs BSP vs Cat caveats

subAgents.name: Branch Fulfillment Agent
responsibilities: Check Fremont, Hayward, Livermore, Kent, Tacoma, Seattle, Portland, Austin stock
Estimate crimping capacity and wait time
Propose pickup branch or van staging
subAgents.contextHandoff: Fulfillment plan with ETA and location

subAgents.name: Customer Comms Agent
responsibilities: Send SMS/email with ETA and location directions
Log job notes for the counter team
subAgents.contextHandoff: Approved customer communication + POS-ready job ticket

multiAgent.conflictResolution: Any low-confidence pressure rating or fitting standard match requires human counter tech approval before assembly. Inventory conflicts prefer in-branch stock over speculative transfers. Emergency van jobs outrank routine quotes when safety/downtime risk is high. Credit holds always escalate to humans.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Capture customer need via counter, phone, email, or photo of failed hose/fitting; include machine type, pressure, and location (CA/WA/OR/TX).

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor classifies as standard assembly, specialty fitting hunt, or mobile emergency and selects agent path.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Agents identify parts, price the assembly, check multi-branch stock/crimper capacity, and draft dispatch or pickup options.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Certified hose specialist verifies high-pressure specs, crimp specs, and final assembly quality before release to customer.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Customer gets quote/ETA, assembly is completed at counter or by mobile van, and job history updates inventory and CRM.

apis: Email (fremont@, kent@, portland@, austin@ location inboxes)
vectorDbs: Hose & fitting cross-reference catalogs (SAE, metric, BSP, JIS, Caterpillar)
Manuli hose specialist guides and crimp specs
Historical job tickets and common machine BOMs
Branch hours, services, and mobile coverage playbooks
legacySystems: Vendor punchout or email PO workflows
security: No auto-approval of high-pressure crimp specs without tech sign-off
Customer PII minimization on quotes and SMS
Role-based access to pricing and credit data
Audit trail for assembly recommendations and overrides
